title: Bound Maker-GTD expiry preflight without fabricating fills
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Ensure an expired exact ETH Reference Average Maker-GTD Paper order reaches one atomic terminal outcome within a finite preflight window even when a WebSocket receipt or its accepted side-effect work does not complete, while preserving every successfully processed pre-expiry fill and all existing signal, execution, accounting, Paper-only, and Live boundaries.
inScope: Apply one absolute Maker expiry-preflight deadline at effective expiry plus the existing MarketDataWebSocket:StaleAfterSeconds value; the current production/default value is 30 seconds and the existing five-second Paper lifecycle cadence remains unchanged.

Use the same absolute deadline across fair receipt admission and the exact-order accepted pre-expiry side-effect drain, so multiple same-expiry orders do not each add another full wait and no one in-memory preflight await can block the open-order worker indefinitely.

If receipt admission and every matching accepted pre-expiry update complete before the deadline, preserve the current evidence parser, priority drain, authoritative TouchNoDepth fill, continuity classification, linked-run checks, and atomic fill-or-expiry behavior unchanged.

If the absolute deadline is reached before receipt admission or matching side-effect drain completes, stop waiting but do not cancel or discard the underlying receipt/queue work; atomically terminalize the still-Pending exact-family order as maker_gtd_evidence_unavailable with a persisted phase-specific preflight-deadline detail and timestamps.

Preserve atomic race safety: if valid market data fills first, expiry becomes not eligible; if deadline expiry wins first, later receipt/side-effect completion cannot fill, reopen, or otherwise mutate the terminal order/run.
Distinguish service shutdown/caller cancellation from the internal deadline: shutdown propagates cancellation and must not be converted into a financial or terminal mutation.

Add deterministic lifecycle and worker regressions for never-completing receipt admission, never-completing side-effect drain, same-expiry cohorts, completion just before the deadline, deadline-versus-fill races, cancellation, exact diagnostics, and subsequent worker recovery.

Document the finite fail-closed preflight rule and its explicit Paper availability tradeoff, build and focused-test it, independently review it, preserve the approval-parent history, and merge/push the verified result through codex/reference-average-available-windows.
outOfScope: Changing Reference Average signals, windows, thresholds, direction, selected outcome, order price, stake, entry timing, GTD/PostOnly intent, TouchNoDepth inference for work completed before the deadline, mandatory label, fee/PnL/settlement formulas, or Live behavior.
Fabricating a fill or an ordinary expired-unfilled result when receipt/side-effect completion is unknown; replaying, reopening, rewriting, or directly expiring existing production rows.

Canceling, dropping, coalescing, interrupting, or reordering an accepted market-data update; changing queue capacity, general queue scheduling, WebSocket subscriptions, reconnect logic, stale detection, frame parsing, database schema, repository query shape, or runtime configuration values.

Claiming this correction fixes the underlying Polymarket WebSocket disconnection or the unidentified internal operation that held the observed receipt/preflight open; this task bounds its impact on exact Maker expiry only.
Changing lifecycle behavior for non-Maker Paper orders, generic copied-trader Paper, Live orders, shadows, Child strategy selection, Dashboard projections, position marks, or settlements.
Deploying, restarting, reconfiguring, or mutating production or an external venue; production verification occurs only after the user deploys the merged revision.

requirements.text: Exact Maker-GTD expiry preflight must have one absolute, expiry-based deadline that prevents an incomplete receipt or side-effect operation from blocking the lifecycle worker indefinitely.
acceptanceCriteria: The deadline is effective_expires_at_utc plus the positive existing MarketDataWebSocket.StaleAfterSeconds interval; it is not reset per poll, per order, between admission and drain, or after a partial preflight step.
A receipt admission or exact-order side-effect drain that completes before the deadline follows the unchanged current path and never receives a timeout classification.
A receipt admission that is still pending at the deadline stops blocking the pass; a side-effect drain that is still pending at the same deadline does likewise.
Four or more orders sharing one expiry and one stuck preflight operation all reach terminal attempts from that same absolute deadline without serially accumulating one stale interval per order.
Caller/service cancellation remains cancellation; only expiration of the internally computed deadline authorizes the new fail-closed path.
The worker remains usable on later cycles after a deadline path, and handoff/queue cancellation cleanup leaves later admissions and drains operational.

requirements.text: A Maker-GTD preflight deadline must resolve uncertainty as explicit evidence-unavailable and preserve atomic exactly-one terminal behavior without changing successful pre-deadline fills.
acceptanceCriteria: When the deadline wins and the order is still Pending, the existing atomic repository mutation persists PaperOrder=Expired and linked run=Skipped with reason maker_gtd_evidence_unavailable; diagnostics identify receipt_admission_timeout or side_effect_drain_timeout, the absolute deadline, effective expiry, and evaluation timestamp.
The deadline path never persists maker_gtd_expired_unfilled, a Paper fill, shares, position, PnL, fee, settlement, or Live/shadow record from incomplete evidence.

Underlying receipt and side-effect work is not canceled or discarded by the deadline. If it later finishes, existing atomic eligibility prevents it from filling/reopening a terminal order; a deterministic race test proves exactly one of fill or expiry wins.

If accepted pre-expiry touch evidence is processed before the deadline, the current TouchNoDepth full-fill path still fills exactly once with unchanged v1/v2 contract, label, price, size, order/run/fill linkage, and Paper-only/Live-disabled predicates.

Malformed order evidence, missing linked run, recorded handler failure, connection continuity changes, timestamp precision, and repository NotEligible behavior retain their existing fail-closed meanings unless the new deadline itself is the first unresolved blocker.
No existing terminal production record is replayed or rewritten; the four preview rows can change only through ordinary runtime processing after a future user deployment.

deviations.text: After effective expiry plus the existing WebSocket stale interval, allow an unresolved accepted pre-expiry receipt or side-effect operation to lose authority to create a Paper fill for that order; terminalize it as evidence-unavailable while allowing the underlying work itself to finish normally.
deviations.impact: This guarantees finite Maker lifecycle progress and prevents one incomplete in-memory operation from blocking all open-order processing, but a real pre-expiry touch contained in work that completes only after the deadline will not become a Paper fill. The result can understate Paper fills, positions, and PnL relative to waiting forever. It never fabricates a win/loss, changes Live trading, or cancels/drops the underlying market-data work.
